title: Vapor Pressure and Dissolution Enthalpy Measurements in Ternary {H2O + NaCl + Na2SO4} System between 298 K and 363 K
experimental_method: Vapor pressure: nonisothermal static device (Pt100, MKS Baratron absolute manometer) at constant composition; dissolution enthalpy: Setaram C80D differential calorimeter.
uncertainties_stated: T +-0.01 K; pressure accuracy +-0.1%; composition +-0.001 mol/kg (vibrating-tube densimeter); calorimeter accuracy of masses +-0.1 mg; reproducibility NaCl series 1.5% relative mean deviation.

Table 1.printed: 210 data points in 15 blocks (14 per block) + 15 label rows

Table 2.printed: 89 data points in 9 blocks + 9 label rows

not_extracted_tables.reason: Appelblat fit coefficients A, B, C for each composition (fitted correlation, not measured data)
Pitzer model parameters and dissolution enthalpies at infinite dilution (model parameters)
deviations of Pitzer and NRTL calculations from literature data (model comparison)

quality_remarks: (1) Text says the m1=m2 solutions span 0.2625 to 1.04915 mol/kg; Table 1 label has 1.0495 (and Table 3 also 1.0495): likely a text/table rounding difference. (2) Text says the 1/10 solutions have m2 = 0.2448 to 1.3596; Table 1 and Table 3 have lowest m2 = 0.2484 (digits transposed in the text). (3) Abstract and Section 2.2 say the dissolution enthalpies were measured at 297.8, 317.5, 332.4 K 'respectively' for ratios 1/10, 1, 10/1, but Table 2 contains every ratio at all three temperatures (297.75, 317.45, 332.35 K). (4) Table 2 caption carries a stray closing quote. (5) Table 2 10/1 block at 317.45 K has 7 points in the left group and 8 in the right. (6) T range of Table 1 298.31-362.26 K, matches 298-363 K in text. (7) Temperature scale not stated. (8) The 'aw' column is derived by the authors from Pexp; 'aw Appelblat' is calculated from their fit.
extraction_notes: Captured table list contained 52 fragments: Table 1 split in 31 pieces (header, label, data), Table 2 split in 13 pieces (T labels missing for blocks 4-9, recovered from wrapper_text), Tables 4 and 5 repeated 3 times. Fragments concatenated in order by script; side-by-side column groups stacked. Checks: Table 1 block count equals 8 (m1=m2) + 7 (1/10) as stated in the text; Table 2 data count equals the 45 printed lines x 2 groups - 1 empty cell = 89. Only Unicode minus normalised (Table 2 enthalpies); thin spaces in labels normalised to ASCII spaces.
mapping_audit: independent mapping audit 2026-10-02 (audit.json); cell-for-cell match with the captured HTML rows
